interaction_law.recognition: lock and key: a ligand binds a site when at least match_bits of the shape_bits positions are complementary (bit-inverted)
interaction_law.conformational_fusion: Mg2+ and Ca2+ bind the modulator site and select a conformer; the conformational dynamics fuses the milieu signals nonlinearly, so the catalytic activity is a nonmonotonic function of each signal concentration
interaction_law.response: r = NADH absorbance at 339 nm at a fixed time after initiation; measured to rise to a maximum and then fall along both ion axes
interaction_law.signal_coding: a 1-signal is the presence of one encoding unit of the carrier ions, a 0-signal their absence; two input lines give milieu states a (00), b (01 or 10) and c (11)
interaction_law.signal_strength: Delta s = min(r over the milieu states that must be active) - max(r over the rest); the operation is realisable iff Delta s > 0
interaction_law.output: threshold the response; above threshold is an active output

experiment.source: K.-P. Zauner and M. Conrad, Enzymatic Computing, Biotechnol. Prog. 17(3):553-559, 2001 (doi:10.1021/bp010004n)
experiment.enzyme: mitochondrial malate dehydrogenase, pig heart (ICN Biomedicals); 6 uL/mL of the suspension in the enzyme solution - its molar concentration is not published
experiment.readout: NADH absorbance at 339 nm, 1 cm light path

response_surface.design: 6 x 6 MgCl2 x CaCl2 factor levels, run as 7 blocks of 6 cuvettes
response_surface.ion_levels_uL: 0; 25 of 2 M; 25, 50, 75, 100 of 4 M, made up to 300 uL
response_surface.shape: rises to a maximum and then falls along both ion axes ('convex', i.e. strictly nonmonotonic)
